body: techcrunch.com: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.
wired.com: Meta’s biggest model rivals the world’s best—and includes new features to keep agents from going off the rails.

techmeme.com: Jonathan Vanian / CNBC : Muse Wonder is available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, while Muse Wonder Full is available to Muse Code subscribers Meta debuted its latest artificial intelligence model, Muse Wonder, and says it's the most advanced option for powering digital assistants. But it doesn't come for free.

techmeme.com: Robert Hart / The Verge : Meta says it plans to power its Muse AI agent with Wonder, starting with subscribers, and will develop specialized models it can bring to everyone using Muse Meta says the models compete with the industry's best and will soon power its Muse agent. Meta is making up for lost time in the AI race.

stories.h: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "AI first" game development model
stories.s: Epic Games is shifting to an "AI first" development strategy for its collaboration with the Walt Disney Company, letting AI models write all the code and guide all the artwork for an upcoming shooter.
b: arstechnica.com: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "AI first" game development model
techmeme.com: Sources: Epic has delayed the release of an upcoming game, instructing developers to implement an "AI first" production model with "no more hand-written code" (Jason Schreier/Bloomberg)
body: arstechnica.com: Epic Games is shifting to an "AI first" development strategy for its collaboration with the Walt Disney Company, letting AI models write all the code and guide all the artwork for an upcoming shooter. That's according to a Bloomberg report , which cites unnamed people familiar with the project who commented on the significant pivot in internal development at the Unreal Engine maker. Human developers will be tasked with managing and guiding code and art assets generated by models such as Anthropic's Claude, according to internal Epic employee messages viewed by Bloomberg. That means "no more hand-written code" and art assets "generated with full AI workflows," according to the report. The $1.5 billion collaboration between Epic and Disney, announced in early 2024 , was slated to release a Marvel- and Star Wars-themed shooter in March 2027. That project has now been delayed indefinitely amid the AI-related shakeup and understaffed, slower-than-expected development thus far, according to the report. Read full article Comments
